scope: Stage-two development screens on explicit seeds14 and15 only. The earlier final-validation seeds are now reused as development data. Future holdout outcomes are excluded before any score read.

descriptions.frontier-volume: Larger daily capacity0.35 and unbooked allowance0.08, minimum supply8, max700km; four parameter changes together.
descriptions.frontier-shadow: Capacity0.50, backlog0.12, minimum supply8, max700km, and expected cost multiplier2.0; tests aggressive cost-based pricing jointly with looser admission.
descriptions.frontier-lowfee: Volume settings plus opening fee0.85 instead of1.05. Also changes quote floors and demand-model cost inputs; not an isolated payout experiment.
descriptions.frontier-auction: Defer commercial admission until five minutes before response, with an initial losing placeholder; prioritize due requests by expected contribution and reserve pending capacity later.
descriptions.frontier-private: Allow feasible private-address single-car work while retaining baseline price/capacity settings.
descriptions.frontier-trade: Allow feasible two-leg trade-ins while retaining baseline price/capacity settings.
descriptions.frontier-menu: Same-day menu price multiplier1.12; later options unchanged.
descriptions.frontier-volume-auction: Combines the larger volume admission settings with deferred quote-window allocation.
descriptions.frontier-readiness: Readiness-aware admission/timing treatment; inspect the full stored settings and frozen source.
descriptions.frontier-place: Place-aware demand treatment; inspect the full stored settings and frozen source.
descriptions.frontier-bundles: Hold safe public single-car posts for up to15 minutes and match feasible sequential pairs; retain baseline admission and prices.
descriptions.frontier-volume-bundles: Pairing plus capacity0.35, backlog0.08, minimum supply8 and maximum700km.
descriptions.frontier-auction-bundles: Pairing plus deferred commercial quoting five minutes before the response deadline.
descriptions.frontier-hold-control: Hold posts for15 minutes but disable route pairing; isolates the posting delay.
descriptions.frontier-long-bundles: Pairing plus maximum700km, retaining baseline capacity, backlog and minimum supply.
descriptions.frontier-home: Cheap direct offers to qualified drivers living near the destination, retaining baseline admission.
descriptions.frontier-home-volume: Destination-home offers plus the four broader volume settings.

lateDefinition: An order is late if any leg is undelivered or exceeds its deadline; a private delivery uses min(order deadline, booked slot end + 30 minutes). The derived count reconciles to the terminal score.
limitations: Two-seed adaptive screening is descriptive and cannot certify generalization or optimality.
Volume, shadow and lowfee labels represent coupled treatments; inspect full settings.
Order-set and ledger attribution is arithmetic on observed paths, not a causal mediation analysis.
Decision-point fork probes are not counted as full-week policy trials.
No future holdout outcomes were inspected.
Only terminal snapshots with score, reveal and events enter aggregate outcomes. Interrupted/incomplete attempts remain in the run manifest; their lack of a score is not a policy delivery failure.
